linux.cli_template: --server Server.Name="%HOSTNAME%" Server.Password="" Server.ListenPort=%PORT% Server.AdvertiseOnline=True Server.AdvertiseOnLocalNetwork=True Server.EnableSingleplayer=True Server.RecordReplays=False Engine.SupportDir="%HOME_PATH%/data/gse"
linux.post_install: github_asset() { curl -fsSL "https://api.github.com/repos/$1/releases/latest" | python3 -c ' import json, sys wanted = sys.argv[1] for asset in json.load(sys.stdin)["assets"]: if wanted in asset["name"]: print(asset["browser_download_url"]) break ' "$2" } url="$(github_asset OpenRA/OpenRA "Red-Alert-x86_64.AppImage")" curl -fL --retry 3 -o openra.AppImage "$url" chmod +x openra.AppImage ./openra.AppImage --appimage-extract > /dev/null rm -rf openra mv squashfs-root openra rm -f openra.AppImage
